title: 00 · Linux basics
summary: New to the terminal? Connect to a server, learn the commands you'll use every day, keep long analyses running with byobu, and add programs to your PATH.
series: Part 1 · From raw reads to population structure

title: 00 · Setup: conda and project organization
summary: Install the programs with conda, without administrator access, and organize your project folders so data, scripts and results stay apart.
series: Part 1 · From raw reads to population structure

title: 01 · Raw reads: quality control and cleaning
summary: Are the reads good? Check their quality with FastQC and MultiQC, then remove barcodes and adapters and trim low-quality bases with fastq-mcf.
series: Part 1 · From raw reads to population structure

title: 02 · Mapping and SNP calling
summary: From clean reads to a VCF: map to a reference genome with BWA and call variants with FreeBayes, or build loci de novo with Stacks when there is no reference.
series: Part 1 · From raw reads to population structure

title: 03 · Filtering the VCF
summary: Which samples and SNPs to keep? Filter for quality and missing data, choose the right VCF for each analysis, and find outlier SNPs with pcadapt.
series: Part 1 · From raw reads to population structure

title: 04 · Genetic diversity and differentiation
summary: How diverse is each population, and how different are they? Estimate π, heterozygosity, F<sub>IS</sub>, private alleles and pairwise F<sub>ST</sub> with Stacks populations.
series: Part 1 · From raw reads to population structure

title: 05 · PCA and DAPC in RStudio
summary: How are the individuals grouped, without a model? Explore the structure with a PCA and find genetic clusters with DAPC, step by step in RStudio.
series: Part 1 · From raw reads to population structure

title: 06 · STRUCTURE and fastSTRUCTURE
summary: How many genetic clusters, and what is the ancestry of each individual? Run STRUCTURE and fastSTRUCTURE, choose K, and plot the results with pophelper.
series: Part 1 · From raw reads to population structure

title: 07 · sNMF and TESS3: ancestry coefficients and maps
summary: Fast alternatives to STRUCTURE: ancestry coefficients with sNMF (without geography) and TESS3 (with coordinates), as bar plots and on a map.
series: Part 1 · From raw reads to population structure

title: 08 · conStruct: structure and isolation by distance
summary: Discrete groups, continuous isolation by distance, or both? Compare spatial and non-spatial models with conStruct and cross-validation.
series: Part 1 · From raw reads to population structure

title: 09 · EEMS: effective migration surfaces
summary: Where are the barriers and corridors to gene flow? Map effective migration and diversity surfaces with EEMS.
series: Part 1 · From raw reads to population structure

title: 10 · FEEMS: fast effective migration surfaces
summary: The fast successor of EEMS: migration surfaces with the smoothing chosen by cross-validation, on a grid made for your study area.
series: Part 1 · From raw reads to population structure

title: Start here: phylogenomics overview and installing the tools
summary: What these analyses need (an outgroup in the VCF), which tutorials are coming next, and how to install PAUP*, Dsuite, Ruby and the other tools.

title: 01 · SVDQuartets with PAUP*
summary: How are the individuals or populations related? Infer lineage and species trees from SNP data under the multispecies coalescent, with bootstrap support.

title: 02 · Ancestry painting
summary: Are putative hybrids heterozygous at sites fixed between the parents? Test hybrid origin and tell F1s from later-generation hybrids and backcrosses.

title: 03 · Dsuite: D statistics, f4-ratio and f-branch
summary: Is there excess allele sharing between groups? Test for gene flow with ABBA-BABA statistics, f4-ratios and f-branch, with multiple-testing correction.
